function.name: uber_ride
function.description: Initiates an Uber carpool ride from a specified location and provides options for ride type, along with an estimated wait time for the customer. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loc.description: The starting location for the Uber ride in the format of 'Street Address, City, State'. For example, '1 Market St, San Francisco, CA'.

type.description: The type of Uber ride the user is requesting.

time.description: The maximum time the customer is willing to wait for the ride, in minutes.

I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t tell you the exact temperature or conditions at this moment. However, here’s what you can do:

| Option | How it works |
|--------|--------------|
| **Google Search** | Type “Hanoi weather today” into Google (or your preferred search engine). It will show a quick‑look card with the current temperature, wind speed, precipitation chance, and a short outlook. |
| **Weather Apps/Websites** | Check sites such as <https://weather.com>, <https://accuweather.com> or use apps on iOS/Android. Just enter “Hanoi” and you’ll get hourly forecasts, radar maps, UV index, pollen counts, etc. |
| **Local News & Radio** | Many Vietnamese news outlets broadcast daily weather summaries—especially during peak traffic hours. |

### Quick Climate Snapshot (Typical)

| Season | Avg Temp (°C) | Rainfall | Notes |
|--------|---------------|----------|-------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 12 – 20 | Low | Cooler nights, occasional drizzle |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 19 – 28 | Moderate | Warm days, increasing rainfall toward May |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 26 – 34 | High | Hot, humid, monsoon rains common |
| Autumn (Sep–Nov) | 22 – 30 | Variable | Mild evenings, rain peaks around Oct |

If you need more detailed predictions (e.g., tomorrow’s high/low, air quality), let me know and I can guide you through setting up alerts on one of those platforms!
